book.commonName: Saveeŋ Tau Ipaghazoŋai Ŋgar Yoŋgaaŋa To Maaron
book.title: Saveeŋ Tau Ipaghazoŋai Ŋgar Yoŋgaaŋa To Maaron Kamapim Tok Hait—Revelation

content: Sipsip to Maaron iwalaav bagil liim ve ru
Ra yau naghita Sipsip to Maaron igham rau tau bagil liim ve ru tigheen ila na, ve iwalaav bagil ee imin maata.
Ve nalooŋ gabua matazi yaryaare paaŋ, toozi ee iboob aliiŋa tiina kat imin lalaav luutu ighe: “Ulam!”
Ve matag ila le naghita hos pisosooŋa ee. Ŋeer tau ilandoova na ikis paneegh, ve tigham le moghar ndamoonda ee. Pasaa, i iparav ariaaŋ toman koiŋa siriv ve iliiv zi wa. Tauta ila ighe iparav muul.
Mako Sipsip to Maaron iwalaav bagil ite izi, ve nalooŋ gabua matazi yaryaare paaŋ, toozi ite isaav ighe: “Ulam!”

Tauvene hos ite ivot ila. Hos tawe, siŋsiŋai kat imin yav yaama. Ve tigham mbuzaagh tiina ee pa ŋeer tau ilandoova na, ve tiyok pani to ipaghau lepoogh poia pa tamtamon to taan, ve ipazaagh zi pa malmal. Leso tivaravu zi gha timatmaat.

Mako Sipsip to Maaron iwalaav bagil ite imin tol izi, ve nalooŋ gabua matazi yaryaare paaŋ, toozi ite imin tol, isaav ighe: “Ulam!” Ra matag ila le naghita hos gabgabuai ee. Ve ŋeer tau ilandoova na, i ŋeer to ighamgham nibib. Tauvene ikis sikel ila niima.

Malau mako ve nalooŋ ŋeer ee aliiŋa ivot ila gabua matazi yaryaare paaŋ tawe sosozi ighe: “Pitool aat ivot. Ve aniiŋ atuya pale izala kat. Isaav ighe tamtamon tigham uraat pa aaz ee, atuya tau tigham pa uraat toozi, ene irau tighol aniiŋ tiina pani mako. Aniiŋ bali tau atuya raurauai, yes pale irau tighol uur geegeu tol ma vene. Ve aniiŋ wit, atuya toozi tawe pale irau tighol uur marani eemon geeg. Eemon uvaghamunia ai oliv ve vaen sov.”
Mako Sipsip to Maaron iwalaav bagil ite imin paaŋ izi, ve nalooŋ gabua matazi yaryaare paaŋ, toozi ite imin paaŋ, isaav ighe: “Ulam!”

Ra matag ila le naghita hos yaŋooŋa ee. Ve ŋeer tau ilandoova na, tiwaat eeza tighe: ‘Mateegh.’ I imuuŋ, ve nugh to mateegha itaghoni. Ve tivalagh tamtamon tisov to taan timin ŋgun paaŋ, ve tighur ŋgun ee ila yesuru nimazi, leso tirav zi timatmaat. Tauvene tirav tamtamon siriv pa mbuzaagh. Ve siriv, pitool tiina ve moroghooŋ sasaghati irav zi. Ve siriv, gabua sagsagŋa tighan zi gha timatmaat.

Mako Sipsip to Maaron iwalaav bagil ite imin liim izi, ve naghita eval tiina anunuzi tileep ila artaal to nugh sambam saamba. Yes tawe, muuŋ titaghon saveeŋ onoon to Maaron ve tipariaaŋ tamtamon to tighur ila to Yesu. Tauta yes to tighur koi pa Maaron na, tirav zi timatmaat.
Yes tiboob toman aliŋazi tiina kat tighe: “O Maaron, yo saksakim ve patabuyaaŋ, ve avom onoon. Ŋeez o ugabiiz tamtamon tau tileep izi taan na, ve uyat siŋ tsiei?”

Ra tigham tamtamon tawe lezi nonoghiiŋa pisosooŋa mamalaua le irau zi, ve tisaav pazi tighe: “Atemim izi, ve asaŋan rig. Pa toŋvetaz tsiam siriv tau tibesbees pa Krisi na, Maaron ighur zi ighe timaat raraate imin yam. Saawe tau tirav zi le tisov, mako iyat siŋ tsiam.”
Mako naghita Sipsip to Maaron iwalaav bagil ite imin liim ve ee izi, le yogyoog tiina kat itok taan. Ve aaz maata gabgabuuŋ imin uuli gabgabuai to moŋiiŋ, ve kaiyo paam, maata siŋsiŋaaŋ imin siŋ.
Ve pitum tau tigheen ila sambam saamba na, pale titaptap tizilam taan imin ai fik tau anooŋa ŋgaala ve yaghur tiina itoki le titaptap tizi.
Ve tizuur sambam saamba ila pa ziige ee imin rau tau tilulunu. Ve tizuur loloz tomania sisi tisov tighau pa niazi paam.

Tauvene yes kinik to taan tomania yes tau ezazi tintiina, ve daaba to yes zaaba, kuaz tauŋa, yes tau lezi tapirizi tiina, yes besooŋa, ve yes tau besooŋa mako ve tiŋgin tauzi na, tisov tila tiyooŋ ila maet purazi ve maet tintiina to loloz sosozi.
Ve tiboboob pa loloz ve maet tighe: “Apol alam azala pavomai, ve apoon ghei pa Ŋeer tau ileep ila niia to ghamuuŋ pooz na maata. Leso ighit ghei sov, ve niyooŋ pa aatyavyav to Sipsip tooni.
Pasaa, saawe tiina to titotoi aatyavyav toozi ighe ivot tane. Sei irau iyooz ve ipaloti?”

footnotes.text: Krisi iwalaav bagil liim ve ru, ene ŋgara tauvene: Saawe tau tamtamon to Krisi tileep izi taan, pataŋani maata maata pale igham zi. Eemon Krisi iŋgin pataŋani toozi.
